dispositions.finding: The Go control still accepted a GitHub credential in broker mode.
dispositions.repair: agentopsctl no longer injects a control GitHub token, configuration rejects any such token, and broker-mode control rejects GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN.

dispositions.finding: Persistent PostgreSQL administrator rotation was not possible.
dispositions.repair: Added DRAINING-only transactional administrator rotation, zero-work fencing, new-pass/old-fail authentication proof, secret-safe transport, audit, tests, and the volume-preserving restart runbook.

dispositions.finding: A committed schema-v5 migration could not be restarted by the immutable v4 image.
dispositions.repair: The version gate intentionally rejects v4 after the additive v5 transaction commits. Rollback-safe failure is scoped compensation with volume and broker/audit rows preserved followed by current-image forward recovery; a destructive down migration would violate the durability requirement. This boundary is now explicit in ADR-0017, control-store architecture, and the rotation runbook.

dispositions.finding: The release evidence schema accepted vacuous evidence.
dispositions.repair: Replaced the permissive schema with closed section-specific contracts and added strict Ajv compilation plus a deliberately incomplete fixture rejection.

dispositions.finding: A broker failure could overwrite an expired lease.
dispositions.repair: Failure now requires a live database-clock lease and reports stale/lost ownership; integration coverage proves late failure cannot overwrite the leased row before reclaim.

dispositions.finding: Go broker request creation and requested audit were not atomic.
dispositions.repair: Request insert/dedup and the origin audit now commit in one transaction, with injected-audit-failure integration coverage.

dispositions.finding: Production broker reads lacked explicit pagination and raw-byte bounds.
dispositions.repair: Production gh reads now use explicit bounded pages, a total deadline, raw stdout byte accounting, strict row/item limits, and no generic paginate or jq transform.

dispositions.finding: The PostgreSQL mutable tag was not bound to the running image/spec.
dispositions.repair: PostgreSQL now carries the same sealed image descriptor and full spec digest validation as control/runner and fails closed to the drain/stop/restart path on drift.

dispositions.finding: Codex auth-file Lstat failures could expose the host path.
dispositions.repair: The error is constant and no longer wraps the path-bearing operating-system error.

dispositions.finding: Broker claim or failure persistence errors could stop the colocated execution service.
dispositions.repair: Claim failure now yields a retry without rejection; failure persistence is contained and leaves the request for lease-expiry recovery.

dispositions.finding: Dead removeRunner code and an unreachable runner-absence invariant obscured MONITOR_ONLY behavior.
dispositions.repair: Removed the dead method and documented the intentional MONITOR_ONLY broker runner at the topology branch.
Same repair and regression as the corresponding Codex lease-expiry finding.

dispositions.finding: Pagination had no maximum and pull requests have no provider-side since parameter.
dispositions.repair: Both provider paths now have an exact page maximum; pull-request rows remain locally cursor-filtered and fail closed at the page/item limit rather than silently advancing past an incomplete set.
